sensitivity_trigger: Either hand has <90% with a same-stratum dual-rank candidate, or <80% in strata with >=5 observations per hand.
trigger_note: Conservative descriptive coverage thresholds, not statistical tests or universal standards.
matching_rule: Same focal player, surface, calendar season; traverse left rows by stable match_id within sorted strata; nearest available right row by sum of absolute log focal-rank and log opponent-rank differences, each <=log(1.5); tie by right match_id; no reuse within focal player; no outcomes used.
opportunity_rule: Reapply original minimum per opponent hand after matching; no rematching.
inference: Existing Q3 within-player specification and shared-player dyadic sandwich; retain original IDs, support, identification, residual-df and variance safeguards.
